inputs.name: hand over from Training Data Drift Check to Training Pipeline

output.level_0: The drift check crashes nightly, so the training pipeline runs on stale or corrupted scan lines.
output.level_1: No drift check exists, so the training pipeline silently consumes shifted demand patterns without warning.
output.level_2: A data engineer manually reviews drift reports before triggering the training pipeline each week.
output.level_3: The drift check automatically gates the training pipeline, blocking runs when demand patterns shift.
output.level_4: Governed drift thresholds trigger the training pipeline, with full audit logs for compliance and finance.
